_comment: Optional config for users with multiple ad accounts. Rename to 'accounts.json' to activate. If you only have one account, you can skip this file entirely and rely on .env (META_ACCESS_TOKEN + META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID).
_instructions: 1. Replace placeholder tokens with real Meta access tokens (see references/setup.md)
2. Replace placeholder account IDs (format: act_<digits>, found via list_accounts.py)
3. Set 'aliases' to short names you'd naturally use in chat to refer to each account
4. NEVER commit this file with real values to a public git repository
5. Tokens and IDs below are EXAMPLES ONLY — they will not work
